segments.ne16:1.3: Yathā āyasmā ajito pārāyane bhagavantaṃ pañhaṃ pucchati –
segments.ne16:4.1: “Kenassu nivuto loko”ti pañhe “avijjāya nivuto loko”ti bhagavā padaṃ sodheti, no ca ārambhaṃ.
segments.ne16:4.2: “Kenassu nappakāsatī”ti pañhe “vivicchā pamādā nappakāsatī”ti bhagavā padaṃ sodheti, no ca ārambhaṃ.
segments.ne16:4.3: “Kissābhilepanaṃ brūsī”ti pañhe “jappābhilepanaṃ brūmī”ti bhagavā padaṃ sodheti, no ca ārambhaṃ.
segments.ne16:4.4: “Kiṃsu tassa mahabbhayan”ti pañhe “dukkhamassa mahabbhayan”ti suddho ārambho.
segments.ne16:5.4: Sotānaṃ saṃvaraṃ brūhi, kena sotā pidhīyare”ti.
segments.ne16:7.1: “Savanti sabbadhi sotā, sotānaṃ kiṃ nivāraṇan”ti pañhe “yāni sotāni lokasmiṃ, sati tesaṃ nivāraṇan”ti bhagavā padaṃ sodheti, no ca ārambhaṃ.
segments.ne16:7.2: “Sotānaṃ saṃvaraṃ brūhi, kena sotā pidhīyare”ti pañhe “sotānaṃ saṃvaraṃ brūmi, paññāyete pidhīyare”ti suddho ārambho.
segments.ne16:8.3: Nāmarūpañca [nāmaṃ rūpañca (ka.) passa su. ni.1042] mārisa;
segments.ne16:8.4: Etaṃ me puṭṭho pabrūhi, katthetaṃ uparujjhatī”ti.
segments.ne16:10.1: “Yametaṃ pañhaṃ apucchi, ajita taṃ vadāmi te;
segments.ne16:11.3: Yattha evaṃ suddho ārambho, so pañho visajjito bhavati.
segments.ne16:11.4: Yattha pana ārambho asuddho, na tāva so pañho visajjito bhavati.

lines: Tattha bhagavā padaṃ sodhetīti “avijjāya nivuto loko”ti (su. ni.1039; cūḷani. ajitamāṇavapucchā 58, ajitamāṇavapucchāniddesa 2) vadanto bhagavā –
“kenassu nivuto loko”ti (su. ni.1038; cūḷani. ajitamāṇavapucchā 57, ajitamāṇavapucchāniddesa 1) āyasmatā ajitena pucchāvasena vuttaṃ padaṃ sodheti nāma, tadatthassa vissajjanato.
No ca ārambhanti na tāva ārambhaṃ sodheti, ñātuṃ icchitassa atthassa apariyositattā.
Suddho ārambhoti ñātuṃ icchitassa atthassa pabodhitattā sodhito ārambhoti attho.
Aññāṇapakkhandānaṃ dveḷhakajātānaṃ vā pucchanakāle pucchitānaṃ pucchāvisayo avijaṭaṃ mahāgahanaṃ viya mahāduggaṃ viya ca andhakāraṃ avibhūtaṃ hoti.

Yadā ca bhagavatā paṇḍitehi vā bhagavato sāvakehi apade padaṃ dassentehi nijjaṭaṃ nigumbaṃ katvā pañhe vissajjite mahatā gandhahatthinā abhibhavitvā obhaggapadālito gahanappadeso viya vigatandhakāro vibhūto upaṭṭhahamāno visodhito nāma hoti.

Sodheti nāmāti pucchitamatthaṃ hatthatale ṭhapitaāmalakaṃ viya paccakkhato dassento niggumbaṃ nijjaṭaṃ katvā vivaranto tabbisayaaññāṇasaṃsayādimalāpanayanena sodheti, evaṃ sodhento ca padassa atthena abhedopacāraṃ katvā “padaṃ sodheti” cceva vuccati.
Idha sodhanaṃ nāma paṭicchannarūpassa atthassa desanānubhāvena vivaṭabhāvakaraṇanti tamatthaṃ upamāya vibhāvetuṃ “aññāṇapakkhandānan”tiādi vuttaṃ.
